people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
translations.bsb: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
translations.kjv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
translations.asv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not; O Zion, let not thy hands be slack.
